scope: Frozen body-stage diagnostic with fixed eyes and strength; auditor-selected reachable goals; no learned autonomous goal selection.
goal_error_definition: Mean squared handle position error per coordinate divided by1.8cm squared, plus mean squared rotation-vector error per coordinate divided by11degrees squared; excludes gaze. Lower is better; zero reaches every observed goal pose.

result.goal_source: Observed endpoint of a same-state physical reference with chosen compatible curl/extension, ordinary wrist order and force settings.
result.comparison: Starting controller, direct feasible-hand planner, composed learned-synergy/feasible-hand planner. Strength and gaze are fixed to the controller inside both searches.
result.adoption: Compare common physical-goal error and hand-joint error across independent bodies; no switch is changed by this experiment.
